policy: Source-scoped development controls; no finding closure or independent review implied

controls.sourceDisposition: Measure government grants at fair value. No specified future performance condition: recognise income when receivable. Specified future conditions: recognise income when met. Receipts before recognition criteria are liabilities; tax assistance is assessed separately.

Apply the substantial-difference/substantial-modification assessment in 11.37; no universal ten-percent rule is prescribed there. Separately identify any implementation guidance and qualitative evidence.

Constrain estimated variable consideration to the amount to which entitlement is highly probable on resolution. Use a supported consistent estimate method and update at reporting date; full-IFRS reversal wording is not a substitute.

Separate internal annual review scheduling from indicator-triggered estimate reassessment under 17.19 and reporting-date impairment indicator assessment under Section 27. Internal annual policy does not mandate automatic annual impairment measurement.

Include acquisition-date fair value of previously held interests in staged-acquisition goodwill. Remeasure the prior holding through profit or loss under 19.29. Do not recognise bargain gain before reassessing acquisition inputs; prior OCI follows its applicable requirements.
Deferred tax acquired in a business combination uses Section 29 and employee benefit arrangements use Section 28; do not apply generic fair-value acquisition measurement to these exceptions.

For employees/similar services use granted equity-instrument fair value at grant date. Other parties use reliable goods/services fair value, otherwise equity-instrument fair value, at receipt/service date; classify counterparty and settlement type first.

Acquisition-date contingent consideration uses fair value when reliably available without undue cost or effort, otherwise most likely amount. Initial undue-cost basis is not reassessed later. Equity is not remeasured; other consideration follows current fair value or most-likely basis and profit-or-loss changes.
Assess going concern under 3.8–3.9. Non-going-concern preparation requires disclosure of fact, separately supported basis and reasons; no automatic liquidation valuation follows from the label.
Use all four current-liability OR criteria in 4.7 and the residual 4.8 classification. Missing contract/right evidence is unresolved if no known current criterion settles the outcome.

Include foreign-operation exchange differences among OCI that is not subsequently recycled to profit or loss. Distinguish qualifying hedge reclassification under 11.69; other OCI follows its specific source.
Separate statements permit cost less impairment, fair value through profit or loss, or equity method under 9.26, consistently within each investment class with 9.27 disclosures.
Returns can vary through investee performance including credit/default exposure despite fixed contractual amounts. Assess power, variable returns, their link and principal/agent status together.

An estimate change adjusts related asset/liability/equity carrying amount in the change period under 10.17 where applicable; otherwise recognise prospectively in current or current/future profit or loss. Policy changes and errors use their separate routes.

Require the applicable SME Part I/II basis. Basic debt uses amortised cost except supported current undiscounted cases; qualifying equity follows 11.14(c). No arbitrary full-IFRS fair-value election is established.
Classify the entire fair-value measurement at the lowest-level significant input, even where observable inputs are also present. Input hierarchy classification is not itself a valuation.

Specific identification takes precedence for non-interchangeable items or segregated projects. Other inventories use FIFO or weighted average consistently for similar nature/use; LIFO is not permitted.

Apply the rebuttable twenty-percent significant-influence presumption with participation rights, contrary evidence and exclusion of control/joint control. Do not impose a rigid twenty-to-fifty ownership band.
Separate-statement associate policies follow the three 9.26 choices. Section 14 applies in its own scope with a published-quotation fair-value exception to the cost model.

Establish contractual joint control and arrangement type. Operations recognise own assets/liabilities/expenses and revenue share; assets distinguish own and jointly incurred obligations; entities use their investment model. Do not allocate every item mechanically by ownership percentage.

On loss of supported fair value, dated carrying value becomes Section 17 cost; apply depreciation, impairment and supported capital/restoration changes without resetting to original purchase cost. Return to the applicable fair-value model when reliable FV becomes available. Disclose the change of circumstances.

Split revaluation changes using the same asset history: increases reverse prior profit-or-loss decreases before OCI; decreases consume that asset surplus before profit or loss. Entire-class revaluation and supported fair value remain prerequisites.
Consider significantly different benefit-consumption patterns independently of numeric life differences; allocate initial cost and support each major component life before separate depreciation.

Expense internally generated intangible/R&D expenditure unless it forms part of another asset meeting that section recognition criteria. Never reactivate previously expensed intangible expenditure; the other-asset exception is not permission to capitalise an internal intangible.

For intangibles, the revenue-based amortisation presumption may be rebutted by revenue-defined rights or demonstrated high benefit-consumption correlation under 18.22A. PPE revenue-based depreciation is not appropriate under 17.22.

22.18A expressly permits carrying-amount measurement when reliable fair value is unavailable without undue cost or effort, with 22.20 fact/reasons disclosure. Reassess FV availability before settlement; separate same-ultimate-control exclusions and settlement profit/loss.

Use reporting-date plan-asset fair value under 28.15(b), separately reconciling contributions, benefits paid, actual returns and other changes under 28.41(f). Do not value plan assets by discounting expected returns or contributions.

State comparative information in reporting-date purchasing-power units using a supported general price index. This is not closing-exchange-rate translation; current monetary items and net monetary gain/loss follow separate Section 31 treatment.

A deterioration flag in the subsequent-event process does not automatically override going concern. Reassess substantive management intentions/realistic alternatives and the separately supported basis/disclosures under 3.8–3.9.

A single concession contract can contain both an unconditional grantor payment right and a user-charge right. Recognise supported financial/intangible components separately and reconcile consideration without double counting; subsequent treatment routes to Sections 11/18 and service revenue to Section 23.

Memory/STA integrity and candidate census are engineering controls, not glossary accounting mandates. Use the actual 225-candidate manifest rather than stale 200-machine language; native integrity verification and accounting coverage are separate.
